answer: A fresh agent starts on a low ledge of near-zero trust, earning weight only as independent peers attest to its real work over a long horizon. A refundable stake unlocks slowly, so a clone fleet must fund a separate bond and wait its own vesting window per fake. Honest effort shows a steady delta of contribution, while correlated sybils forfeit capital the moment the funding trail is exposed, making the cost scale linearly with headcount.
